description: This is a test class for the SkillService in the OrangeHRM system. It contains unit tests for methods such as deleteSkills, getSkillById, saveSkill, searchSkill, and getSearchSkillsCount, using mocking frameworks to simulate dependencies.

classes.name: SkillServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the SkillService through various CRUD and search operations, making use of mocks for dependencies.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the SkillService instance and loads test fixture data before each test.

methods.name: testDeleteSkill
methods.description: Tests the deleteSkills method of SkillService, ensuring it calls the DAO with correct parameters and returns expected result.

methods.name: testGetSkillById
methods.description: Tests the getSkillById method, verifying it retrieves the correct Skill object.

methods.name: testSaveSkill
methods.description: Tests the saveSkill method, ensuring the Skill entity is correctly saved via the DAO.

methods.name: testSearchSkill
methods.description: Tests the searchSkill method to verify it returns the correct list of Skill objects based on search parameters.

methods.name: testGetSearchSkillsCount
methods.description: Tests the getSearchSkillsCount method, verifying correct count retrieval based on search parameters.
